name: vibiusmaximus-video
description: Motion-graphic how-to video for VibiusMaximus, built with Remotion

scripts.stills: remotion still src/index.ts HowTo out/stills/scene1-hook.png --frame=125 && remotion still src/index.ts HowTo out/stills/scene3-capture.png --frame=835 && remotion still src/index.ts HowTo out/stills/scene5-board.png --frame=1380
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts HowTo out/raw.mp4 && node scripts/master.mjs out/raw.mp4 out/vibiusmaximus-how-to.mp4
scripts.render:legion: remotion render src/index.ts Legion out/raw-legion.mp4 --image-format=png --crf=16 --x264-preset=slow && node scripts/master.mjs out/raw-legion.mp4 out/vibiusmaximus-legion.mp4 -16 -2
scripts.storyboard: remotion render src/storyboard/index.ts Frames out/storyboard --sequence --image-format=png && remotion still src/storyboard/index.ts Sheet out/storyboard/sheet.png
